assertions.text: Prints the full 2-topic queue (git-kit: 2 findings; plugin-devkit: 1 finding) before asking to start
The queue-start AskUserQuestion names both plugins and their finding counts explicitly, not a bare yes/no
git-kit (topic 1) is shown, its findings' own text is described, and its own scoped 'which findings' ask is described before any fix path is chosen
git-kit's topic is described as executed to a fully closed state (worktree/branch closed) before topic 2 is mentioned
An explicit continue checkpoint ('topic 1 of 2 done, continue?') is described between topic 1 closing and topic 2 starting
plugin-devkit's (topic 2) Scope Manifest or starting-work call is NOT described as built/started until after the continue checkpoint
Never describes building both plugins' Scope Manifests in the same pass, or one dispatch spanning both plugins
